source.author: stat
source.text: illi vix muros limenque egressa iuventus sacra colunt; credas bello rediisse, tot instant plausibus, offensique sedent ad iusta sepulcri.
source.text_original: illi vix muros limenque egressa iuventus / sacra colunt; credas bello rediisse, tot instant / plausibus, offensique sedent ad iusta sepulcri.
source.text_english: There, scarcely having gone out beyond the walls and threshold, the young men and women perform the sacred rites; you would think they had returned from war, so many acclamations press upon them, and the offended sit down to the funeral rites of the tomb.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Tiphys agit tacitique sedent ad iussa ministri; qualiter ad summi solium Iovis omnia circum prona parata deo, ventique imbresque nivesque fulguraque et tonitrus et adhuc in fontibus amnes.
reuse.text_original: Tiphys agit tacitique sedent ad iussa ministri; / qualiter ad summi solium Iovis omnia circum / prona parata deo, ventique imbresque nivesque / fulguraque et tonitrus et adhuc in fontibus amnes.
reuse.text_english: Tiphys is at work, and the silent attendants sit by the commands of their master; just as everything around the throne of supreme Jove is ready, bowed down before the god—winds and rains and snows and lightnings and thunder, and even now the rivers in their springs.
